claims.title: Response security headers missing: X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options / CSP frame-ancestors, Content-Security-Policy
claims.evidence: The app root (HTTP 200) did not set: X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options / CSP frame-ancestors, Content-Security-Policy. These are defence-in-depth against clickjacking, MIME-sniffing and XSS.

remediation.why: Standard response security headers are missing, removing defence-in-depth against clickjacking, MIME-sniffing, protocol downgrade and XSS.
remediation.fix: Set Strict-Transport-Security (HTTPS), X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, X-Frame-Options/CSP frame-ancestors, and a Content-Security-Policy — e.g. via a security-headers middleware.
